review_notes.en: Short, casual English game tips for review; not applied to the game. The previous draft is preserved. AntiGravity requirements still need verification per level.

introduction.en: Want to float up? Turn on AntiGravity!

required_level_template.en: You'll need AntiGravity for this one!

antigravity.assignment_note: Only add the required-level tip after verifying that the level requires AntiGravity.

levels.en: The king takes one step in any direction!
Knights jump in an L, right over obstacles!
One-way blocks? Follow the arrow to pass through!
Fancy a different piece? Try a transformer!
Grab every objective to unlock the goal!
Don't let the counter hit zero. The goal will lock!
Watch out for bombs!
Rooks move straight. No diagonal shortcuts!
Don't miss any. You need all three objectives!
The bishop's turn. Think diagonally!
Knights can jump over walls, but can't land on them!
Both pieces are yours. Either one can finish!
Try another piece. Each has its own moves!
Straight or diagonal? The queen does both!
You move, the bombs move too!
More than one piece can move. Click another!
Counter hits zero? The goal closes!
Follow the arrow. One-way blocks don't work in reverse!
Move the piece below, and the ones above may drop!
Your own pieces can block the way too!
Bishops go diagonal, rooks go straight. Pick your piece!
Objectives at both ends of the top. Don't miss one!
Split up! Everyone's objectives count together.
New piece, new moves!
Any order works. Just grab all three!
Switching pieces won't restart the counter!
One counter for everyone. Make those moves count!
Both objectives, then the goal. All before zero!
Grabbing an objective won't refill the counter!
Step onto the transformer. What will you become?
Fog ahead! You can only see squares your pieces can reach.
Bishops go diagonally down as well as up!
One step for the king. Diagonals count too!
Nothing underneath? Down you go!
Follow the arrow to get through a one-way block!
The knight can jump over it. The bishop can't!
Close to the goal? You still need every objective!
The goal's right there! But grab all three objectives first.
The queen has range, but the knight can jump obstacles!
Even a rook can transform. Try a new set of moves!
Got the objective? Now reach the goal!
One grabs the objective, another takes the goal. That works!
Only this piece transforms. The others stay as they are.
Moving a lower piece? Watch for falling friends!
An L-shaped jump takes the knight right over obstacles!
So many knights! Any one can grab the objective.
Remember, the king can step diagonally too!
Fog or no fog, the king still moves one square!
Jump over bombs, not onto them!
The counter's still ticking in the fog. Keep an eye on it!
Heads up! These bombs move diagonally!
Step into a portal and pop out at its matching color!
Try castling! Click the king, then an eligible special rook.
Match the colors. Don't mix up the portals!
A platform that goes up and down. Hop aboard!
Get on the platform and ride along!
Same color, same pair. Match your portals!
Want to castle? Neither the king nor special rook can have moved!
Transform all you like. You still need all three objectives!
One castle, two pieces on the move!
Let the knight and bishop share the work. Objectives count together!
Move either piece, and the platform moves too!
Three objectives and the goal. Get them all before zero!
Don't forget those three objectives while you're castling!
The queen and knight can both collect. Share the work!
Purple goes to purple. Match those colors!
No going against a one-way block. Check the arrow!
Three objectives. Miss one and the goal stays locked!
The knight jumps in an L; the king takes one step. Each has its uses!
Pawns move upward. Their first move can cover two squares!
Watch out for ducks. Don't bump into them!
Stand on top of a duck and hitch a ride!
Ducks aren't just in the way. They can give you a ride!
One row goes left, the other right. Watch both!
Grab both objectives to open the goal!
Rooks can hitch a duck ride too. Hop on!
Platforms can go sideways too!
Want to castle? Clear the path between king and special rook!
A duck can carry the bishop sideways. The bishop still moves diagonally!
Hold on! This platform carries you sideways!
That two-square pawn move? First move only!
Blue goes to blue. Check the color!
Green goes to green. In one, out the other!
Pawns can transform too. Pick a new piece and keep going!
Objective one square diagonally ahead? The pawn can capture it!
You move, the platform, ducks, and bombs move too!
Blue to blue, orange to orange. Keep the pairs straight!
Where does orange lead? The other orange portal!
Three platforms, all moving sideways. Watch where they go!
Pawns can't move sideways. Ducks can give them a lift!
Platforms and portals won't change those L-shaped knight moves!
Need different moves? Head to the transformer!
Passing through an objective collects it. No need to stop!
Rook move or bishop move, it all uses the same counter!
Either piece can collect. Let them both join the search!
Portals are fast, but they won't reset the counter!
Jump over ducks, not into them!
Pawns can capture objectives diagonally, one square at a time!
A familiar route. This time with fog and a counter!
Move a knight below, and the ones above may tumble!
Bright edges show where lasers fire. Your moves trigger them!
These lasers don't all fire to the same beat!
Capture the black piece to unlock the goal!
Bad laser timing? A hop in place counts as a move too!
Two objectives, three black pieces. Don't miss any!
